Execute: adb shell "node -e 'const mazeSize=4;let mazeLayout=[];class SeededRNG{constructor(s){this.seed=s;}random(){const a=1664525,c=1013904223,m=2**32;this.seed=(a*this.seed+c)%m;return this.seed/m;}}const rng=new SeededRNG(1892932127);function generateMaze(){mazeLayout=[];for(let r=0;r<mazeSize;r++){const row=[];for(let c=0;c<mazeSize;c++)row.push("#");mazeLayout.push(row);}const stack=[{row:0,col:0}];const dirs=[[-1,0],[1,0],[0,-1],[0,1]];while(stack.length>0){const{row,col}=stack.pop();mazeLayout[row][col]=" ";if(row===mazeSize-1&&col===mazeSize-1)break;for(let i=dirs.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(rng.random()*(i+1));[dirs[i],dirs[j]]=[dirs[j],dirs[i]];}for(const[dx,dy]of dirs){const nr=row+dx,nc=col+dy;if(nr>=0&&nr<mazeSize&&nc>=0&&nc<mazeSize&&mazeLayout[nr][nc]==="#")stack.push({row:nr,col:nc});}}mazeLayout[0][0]=" ";mazeLayout[mazeSize-1][mazeSize-1]="$";}generateMaze();console.log(mazeLayout.map(r=>r.join("")).join("\n"));' 2>/dev/null || echo 'node not available'"
